analysis:
This pass examined the documentation units and the policy change. No regression was identified.

ModelAutopilotPolicy.swift head lines 21-23 add fail-closed checks on the optional holdSeconds. The value must lie in 0...86400, and a nonzero hold requires loadModelId. Both run before the existing session, revision, selection, expiry, residency, pin and dwell checks. This tightens validation and adds no new acceptance path. Holds come only from coordinator commands, and the coordinator is trusted.

protocol-messages.md head 1355-1380 and telemetry-schema.md head 65-73 add consent-gated fields to the provider-to-coordinator state: capabilities, adopted_models, held_models, busy_reasons/busy_reason, busy_since_ms and transition_stalls. They use closed vocabularies and contain no prompt, credential or identity content. They add no event fields. The docs say coordinators ignore unknown keys and rely on adoption or holds only after the provider reports the capability. These are provider self-reports (ADV-001), not trust or capacity evidence. The docs at 1393-1395 say a status frame cannot make unconfirmed slots routable.

The behavior change at head 1470-1472 matters for availability and routing: held targets are kept out of the idle timer and LRU eviction, and adopted inventory keeps serving after the lease expires. This affects T-029 (idle GPU monopolization) and the coordinator's routing assumptions in TB-002, bounded by the 86400s hold cap.

Coverage limit: ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift (unit 955c6f0e4c27677b:0) was supplied as metadata only. Its many changed ranges (reconcileAutopilotPlacements, snapshot construction, busy reasons, superviseTransitions) were not visible to this pass.

Integration must verify the following:
(1) Holds and adoptions are recorded only for succeeded commands whose target is resident, and they expire correctly.
(2) Adopted models serving after the lease still honor revocation of consent, pause, inventory refresh and model retirement or superseded-build cleanup. Retired or unverified weights must never stay routable (T-012/T-027).
(3) busy_since_ms and transition_stalls are computed from monotonic clocks and stay within bounds.
(4) The new status detail field leaks nothing beyond the closed enum.
